# Business Rules

## RULE-1: Starting Conditions

Status: draft

The player shall begin the game docked at a station with 100 credits and a small cargo hold.

## RULE-2: Fuel Consumption Per Jump

Status: draft

Each hyperspace jump shall consume a fixed or distance-based amount of fuel from the ship's fuel tank.

## RULE-3: Commodity Price Variation

Status: draft

Each commodity shall have a base price modified per system so that price differences create profitable trade routes between systems.

## RULE-4: Elite Rating

Status: draft

The Elite combat rating shall be calculated from the player's accumulated profit and combat kills, progressing through defined rating tiers.
